hints.title: Left Outer Join Requirement
hints.text: Products without an entry in Discounts must still appear in the output with their original prices unchanged.

hints.title: Coalescing Missing Discounts
hints.text: Use coalesce(d.discount, 0) so categories with NULL discounts evaluate to a zero percentage discount.

hints.title: Discount Arithmetic and Ordering
hints.text: Calculate final_price as p.price * (1 - coalesce(d.discount, 0) / 100.0) rounded to 2 decimal places and order by product_id ascending.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```sql
SELECT 
    p.product_id,
    ROUND(p.price * (1 - COALESCE(d.discount, 0) / 100.0), 2) AS final_price,
    p.category
FROM Products p
LEFT JOIN Discounts d ON p.category = d.category
ORDER BY p.product_id ASC;
```

complexity.notes: Hash join between Products and Discounts followed by sorting by product_id.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Inner join would discard products whose categories have no discount.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(D) memory for joining category discount table.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies LEFT JOIN and COALESCE to handle unmatched discount categories.
